relevance_note: Single case report of a boy with infantile Alexander disease and a GFAP variant: "It revealed a de novo heterozygous mutation c.716G>A of p.Arg239His in the exon 4 of GFAPgene."
method_note: Hand-built from a full read of the short paper (no tables; figures are images only); a Python script in scratch assembled the JSON. Four rows: the proband ('patient', rule 5), the two parents and the elder brother, who were tested and were wild type. Parents are labelled 'parent of patient' / 'parent of patient 2' because the testing statement says only 'Both the parents'; the mother is mentioned once (antenatal history) but not individually as tested, so no sex was assigned. No variant rows for the relatives (they carry no variant). The Markdown renders '>' as '>'; spans keep '>' verbatim, while variant values use '>' (c.716G>A). Contradiction: the Results give p.Arg239His (c.716G>A), but the Discussion calls it 'the R239L GFAP gene mutation'; the Results string is recorded and R239L is not. Inheritance recorded de novo because both parents were tested and wild type, but the authors add 'presumed to be a de novo mutation or gonadal mosaicism'. Variant type not recorded: the paper never names the class. Head circumference: 'appearance of macrocephaly due to failure to thrive' is an apparent (relative) appearance; the paper states head circumference was always normal, so macrocephaly is excluded. Normal investigations recorded as excluded abnormalities (D-27): amino acids, organic acids, ammonia, lactate, thyroid, renal and liver function, hearing, and abdominal ultrasonography (the last a whole investigation, written as the paper names it). Checklist judgements: 'hypointense line along the ventricular margin' taken as periventricular rim; developmental regression with no speech at 16 months taken as developmental delay; 'regression in motor and cognitive skills' as cognitive decline. 'No similar history in any family members' is not specific enough to exclude any feature in relatives. Vital status left not reported (only 'Presently, at 16 monthss of age'). cites_prior_report left null (not stated). The Discussion's cited cohorts (Gorospe, Li) are group-level only and get no rows.
